hints.title: Incoming Edge Weights
hints.text: Each node i has a directed edge pointing to edges[i], adding its index i to the score of target node edges[i].

hints.title: Accumulation Array
hints.text: Maintain an array scores initialized to 0. For each index i, add i to scores[edges[i]].

hints.title: Max Score Selection
hints.text: Find the node with the maximum score, breaking ties by choosing the smallest node index.

hints.title: Linear Score Accumulator Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in graph
complexity.notes: Single pass edge accumulation followed by linear scan for maximum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining incoming edges by searching edges repeatedly takes quadratic O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scores array stores 64-bit sums for all nodes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Accumulates incoming weights in linear time using an array.
